description: Rewrite the user's text in one decorative Unicode style to paste into WhatsApp. Styles: bold, italic, monospace, bubble, gothic, double (double-struck), strikethrough, upside-down. Call it once the user has picked a style from this list. These are lookalike characters, not real fonts: accented letters and digits usually stay plain, and screen readers can read the result badly. After calling, display structuredContent.styledText verbatim in a plain-text fenced code block. Inputs are processed by this server to return the result; this tool does not store or log phone numbers or text. It does not access an account or send messages.
name: style_whatsapp_text

styledText.description: Finished text, ready to copy. Display this value verbatim in a plain-text fenced code block; do not normalize, translate or format it again.

title: Restyle text with decorative letters
